key_insight: On a fixed compact manifold, parallel transport convolution is continuous in L² under C² perturbations of the Riemannian metric, subject to the paper’s localization and transport-path conventions.
engineering_relevance: This provides a theoretical robustness foundation for geometric deep-learning operators when the underlying metric changes slightly.
method: Estimate metric-induced changes in geodesics, parallel transport, Jacobi fields, and exponential maps.
Compare transported kernels using uniform bounds away from the cut locus and integral bounds on small-volume neighborhoods.
Control changes in the Riemannian volume measure.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a qualitative stability theorem for continuous signals and continuous reference kernels with sufficiently small normal-neighborhood support, not empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The result gives no explicit robustness rate and relies on localization and transport-path conventions that implementations must respect.
paper_title: Stability of Parallel Transport Convolution under Riemannian Metric Perturbations
